csv_scope_of_work: New and existing structures and infrastructure associated with Shawnee State University s 30-acre athletic complex that includes football stadium, track, baseball stadium, softball stadium and multi-purpose fields. Parking, traffic patterns, security, and upgrades to existing utility infrastructure is also to be considered. Development to include existing main campus venues of soccer/lacrosse and the Rhodes Athletic Center along with a new multi-sport facility to be located at either main campus or the athletic complex. The A/E firm is to demonstrate knowledge of current NCAA Division II sports including, but not limited to: football, basketball, soccer, lacrosse, baseball, softball and volleyball.
